title: Hampden County Sheriff's Office Routinely Shared Detainee Data with ICE
detail: Records show the Hampden County sheriff's office regularly shared detainee data with ICE, raising accountability and civil-liberties concerns about the scope and oversight of local law enforcement collaboration with federal immigration authorities.

title: Surveillance Video Shows ICE Vehicle Striking Man in Houston
detail: Surveillance footage was released showing the moment an ICE vehicle struck a man in Houston, drawing renewed scrutiny of enforcement operations and raising questions about use of force during immigration arrests.
